description.value: Meridian Farm Market is a BC-based farm market chain with a full-service Abbotsford location offering locally sourced produce, grass-fed and finished beef, free-run chicken, a deli counter, bake shoppe, and a broad pantry selection. It sits within a regional chain that emphasizes local and sustainable sourcing across the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland. Touring cyclists will find it a well-stocked stop for fresh fruit, vegetables, meats, dairy, and packaged foods.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: rack at 47m; rack at 75m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Meridian Farm Market Abbotsford location with phone 778-666-2789 matching the OSM tag, and the contact page lists it explicitly. The website shows a comprehensive grocery offering (produce, meats, seafood, deli, dairy, pantry, baked goods), confirming the basic groceries amenity. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, ice, or any cycle-specific amenities appears anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM address field is empty — the physical street address for the Abbotsford location was not returned in the fetched website content (contact page shows 'Address' links but did not render the actual address text).
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible farm market with a confirmed Abbotsford location and active website; a useful resupply stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: BC-based farm market chain… emphasizes local and sustainable sourcing across the Fraser Valley and Lower Mainland
